name: ora
description: Agent-readiness scoring from ora (https://ora.ai): look up or run a 0-100 score and A-F grade for a domain or MCP server, re-run selected checks after a fix, browse the check catalog, discover agent-ready products by intent, and draft a domain's agent discovery files. Read-only and keyless.
tagline: Agent-readiness scores and fixes from ora.ai

config.description: Get ora's cached agent-readiness score for a domain: `score` (0-100), `grade` (A-F), `analysisStatus`, and a layer-by-layer breakdown where each check has a status, details and recommendation. Always try this before `ora.scan`. A domain ora has never scanned answers 404 with `code: DOMAIN_NOT_SCANNED`; run `ora.scan` then. Pass `format: audit` for the documented, versioned audit shape.

domain.description: Domain to look up, e.g. stripe.com.

format.description: `audit` returns the versioned, allowlisted audit shape with internal fields dropped.

siteType.description: Score the cached scan against this site type instead of the detected one.

competitors.description: `1` adds the domain's category leaders and leaderboard neighbours.

config.description: Run a fresh ora agent-readiness scan of a public domain, MCP server URL or MCP App URL (ora documents about 30 seconds, which is also Core's HTTP tool timeout, so a slow scan can come back unavailable: check `ora.score` before retrying). Use only when `ora.score` has no cached result or the user asks for a rescan. Deep checks can finish later: while `analysisStatus` is not `complete`, poll `ora.score` for the same domain.

url.description: Domain, MCP server URL or MCP App URL to scan, e.g. stripe.com.

mcpUrl.description: Optional explicit MCP server URL for the target.

config.description: Re-run selected ora checks against a URL and get per-check results without an aggregate score: the re-verify step after shipping a fix. Check ids come from `ora.checks` or a score's layer breakdown.

url.description: Website, MCP server or API URL to check. A bare domain is accepted.

mcpUrl.description: Optional explicit MCP server URL for the target.

config.description: List ora's full check catalog: every check id with its layer, applicability, maturity and maximum score.
Find agent-ready products that match a need, e.g. `send transactional email`. Each match carries its ora score, grade, category and tags.

intent.description: What the product should do, in plain language.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

config.description: Draft a domain's own agent discovery files (ard.json, ai-catalog.json, poppy.json) from what ora observed. Pass `include: all` to also draft llms.txt, a robots.txt edit, an API catalog and MCP server cards. Drafts only: review them before publishing.

domain.description: Domain to draft files for, e.g. example.com.

include.description: `all` adds llms.txt, a robots.txt edit, an API catalog and MCP server cards.
